answer: The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, published publicly on failure, rewards vest against future work. By the zephyr of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The nadir is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the sable. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
